caseName: Maryland & Virginia Milk Producers' Ass'n v. District of Columbia
caseNameFull: Maryland & Virginia Milk Producers' Assn., Inc. v. District of Columbia
attorneys: Messrs. John S. Barbour and Christopher B. Garnett for petitioner. Messrs. Richmond B. Keech, Vernon E. West, and Glenn Simmon for respondent. Mr. Charles W. opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.
